voice-of-america-metropark.mobility.1: One adult-sized chair and one child-sized chair are available for public use.
The pick-up and drop-off location for both chairs is the Voice of America MetroPark Welcome Center.
Users are welcome to take the GRIT chairs to any park; they do not need to stay at Voice of America MetroPark or in the MetroParks system.
A refundable $75 deposit is required at the time of reservation.
